## The programme

Grenoble INP led its participation in two EIT Manufacturing projects: ***AI for Manufacturing SMEs and Students*** and ***Digiman***. Both delivered training on AI for manufacturing to professionals and students in four countries, in cooperation with companies.

- *AI for Manufacturing SMEs and Students* produced a master's-level module made of **16 case-study "nuggets"** on AI applied to manufacturing, built on the research of the teaching teams; four of them were developed in Grenoble.
- *Digiman* produced an introductory module on AI for manufacturing.

These projects also led to two online courses, including a MOOC on industrial applications of AI.
